name: ProjectMeetingMinutesManager
tagline: OAC and site meeting minutes with an action log that carries itself forward
description: A complete meeting minutes and action-log app for construction projects in one Power Apps code component: minutes by agenda section, actions with owners and due dates, decisions and information notes, carry-forward of open actions to the next meeting with escalation, confirm-and-close at the meeting, kanban board, people chase list and minutes export. Runs in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any table.
features: Minutes by agenda section with Action / Decision / Information / Risk items
Owners, companies, due dates, references and responses
Carry-forward to the next meeting with carry counter and escalation
Confirm & close at the meeting – the owner cannot close their own action
Overdue, due soon, escalate, no owner and to-confirm flags
Bulk assign, status, due date, move to meeting and notes with undo
Minutes text and action-log CSV export
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
